summary.text: GISHOLT & FINNE AS is a private limited company registered in Skien, founded 2002-03-19. GISHOLT & FINNE AS engages in the buying and selling of building materials, along with activities that are naturally connected to this. It was previously named BYGGKJØP GISHOLT & FINNE AS until 2008-12-08. Its main industry code is 47.520: retail sale of hardware, building materials, paints and glass. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 104 293 837 NOK and the annual result was -326 335 NOK; operating income was down from 114 134 649 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -1 661 440 NOK in 2024 to -326 335 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 17 461 007 NOK in 2024 to 17 644 163 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 26 on 2025-11-13 to 25 on 2026-03-13. The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-09 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
